context: `formatError` currently passes every GraphQL error straight through to the client, including whatever message the underlying resolver or database driver threw.
explanation: Safe to merge. Errors with a known, safe extensions.code (BAD_USER_INPUT, UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN) still pass through with their real message so clients can act on them, but anything else is logged server-side with full detail and replaced with a generic "Internal server error" before it reaches the client — preventing stack traces, table names, or driver internals from leaking.
